name: FileFlows
description: FileFlows lets you process files in a rule flow like system. Primary focus is for video file processing, including coverting videos to standard format (hevc/ac3 etc), and other function for example, removing black bars from videos, adding chapter points for comskip/edl files and many more features It supports a Server and mutliple node setup, where you can have one server (with an internal processing node) and additional computers/machines as additional processing nodes. For NVIDIA GPU setup see https://github.com/revenz/FileFlows/wiki/Unraid-NVIDIA-Setup

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Location of the database file, best to set this in appdata

paths.name: Logs
paths.description: logging directory, best to store this with the appdata

paths.name: Temp Directory
paths.description: Where temporary files will be created during the file flow process Best to put this on a cache drive or a faster ssd/nvme

paths.name: /media/
paths.description: Mapping to a folder in unRAID. this is optional and you can add as many as you like.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port used to access the WebUI. The container uses port 5000 this can forward any port to that in the container.

variables.name: TimeZone
variables.description: TimeZone for the container refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones for a list of possible timezones

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: If you have multiple NVIDIA GPUs set a specific ID from the settings page
